message: Love the pictures, Mike.  It's fascinating what you will find if you actually take the time to look.  Carnivals, fairs and festivals are a big thing around here.  From June through September you can allways find a good Catholic festival and since this is area has such a rich German heritage you are certain to find an Oktoberfest celebration every weekend from mid September to November.  Needless to say Summer and Fall is a great time to be in Cincinnati.
